answer: The jade counter is kept in zephyr and canyon shows each reset. An hostile operator hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 176 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
